description: Rådet för främjande av kommunala analyser - Kolada: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rådet för främjande av kommunala analyser - Kolada. Coverage: Rådet för främjande av kommunala analyser - Kolada. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Tillgång till fast bredband om minst 100 Mbit/s, andel (%); Bredbandskollen, mätningar, webb, antal per invånare; Bredbandskollen, mätningar, mobil, antal per invånare; Bredbandskollen, genomsnittligt mätresultat, nedströms, mobil, Mbit/s. Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
